import FeePayout.Spec
import FeePayout.Lemmas
namespace FeePayout
instance instDecidableValidPayout (s : State) (r : Request) : Decidable (ValidPayout s r) := by
  unfold ValidPayout; infer_instance

      applied := r.txId :: s.applied })
  else (.rejected, s)
theorem req_valid_succeeds : ValidSucceeds step := sorry
theorem req_invalid_noop   : InvalidNoop step := sorry
theorem req_authorization  : AuthorizedOnly step := sorry
theorem req_effects        : Effects step := sorry
theorem req_idempotency    : Idempotent step := sorry
theorem req_nonnegative    : NonNegative step := sorry
theorem req_equal_shares   : EqualShares step := sorry
theorem req_fee_collected  : FeeCollected step := sorry
theorem req_conservation   : Conserves step := sorry
end FeePayout

theorem req_idempotency : Idempotent step := by
  intro s r h
  have hv : ValidPayout s r := by
    by_cases hc : ValidPayout s r
    · exact hc
    · simp [step, hc] at h
  have hstep1 : (step s r).1 = Outcome.ok := by simp [step, hv]
  have hstep2 : (step s r).2 = { s with balance := fun a => expectedBalance s r a, applied := r.txId :: s.applied } := by
    simp [step, hv]
  -- rewrite to work with s'
  have hmem : r.txId ∈ ({ s with balance := fun a => expectedBalance s r a, applied := r.txId :: s.applied } : State).applied := by
    simp
  have hnotvalid : ¬ ValidPayout (({ s with balance := fun a => expectedBalance s r a, applied := r.txId :: s.applied } : State)) r := by
    intro hcon
    obtain ⟨_, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, hcon_mem⟩ := hcon
    exact hcon_mem hmem
  constructor
  · intro x
    rw [hstep2]
    simp only
    simp
  · have hstep_eq : step (step s r).2 r = (Outcome.rejected, (step s r).2) := by
      rw [hstep2]
      simp [step, hnotvalid]
    exact hstep_eq
